create_cluttered_environment: create a ClutteredMultiGrid environment with configurable grid size, agents, and number of obstacles
customize_cluttered_grid: customize the ClutteredMultiGrid grid by setting n_clutter, randomize_goal, and walls_are_lava parameters
run_cluttered_step: run a step action in the ClutteredMultiGrid environment and return observation, reward, done, and info
register_cluttered_env: register a ClutteredMultiGrid variant as a Gym environment using register.register with an env_id and entry_point
create_lava_cluttered_env: create a ClutteredMinigridLava environment where obstacles are lava instead of walls
